⏱️ Time/Sequence Animation
ℹ️ Time animation requires a column with time, date, or sequence data
ℹ️ Lower = faster! Try 0.1 or 0.05 for rapid animation
All locations for earlier dates stay on the map. Clears when the cycle loops.
ℹ️ Useful for hurricane tracks, flight paths, etc.
ℹ️ Groups rows by the Time/Sequence field value — all locations sharing the same date appear together, one date-group at a time.
Slower ← → PLAID! (max: 12000)
Shorter ← → Longer (10-50% of points visible)
ℹ️ Like trail-only mode, but with animated pulses
ℹ️ Standard mode: Points appear sequentially with optional trail line.
ℹ️ Simultaneous mode: All points shown at once (ideal for arrows/vectors).
ℹ️ Pulse mode: Animated pulse travels along path connecting points (great for tropical storms, hotspots, flight paths).

⟶ Desire Lines
Draw lines or great circle arcs from many origins to a destination — migrations, trade routes, supply chains.
Step 1: Choose a destination
Click anywhere on the map to place your destination
Pick one point in your data as the destination. Lines will be drawn from all other points to it.
Use this when each row in your data already names its own destination in a column. E.g. a trade-flow table where every row says which country it flows to. Both the origin and destination must be rows in your data with coordinates.
Step 2: Origins
Recommended when multiple rows share the same origin location (e.g. multiple ingredients from the same country)
Step 3: Line Style

ℹ️ Instructions:
